item.title: ModuleNotFoundError Solutions
item.description: Today I encountered a very strange thing. When I tried to use the mmdetection toolkit This is what I entered: $ python tools/test.py configs/faster_rcnn_r50_fpn_1x.py checkpoints/faster_rcnn_r50_fpn_1x_20181010-3d1b3351.pth modeltest And this is how it reported the error: Traceback (most recent call last): File "tools/test.py", line 13, in <module> from tools.fuse_conv_bn import fuse_module ModuleNotFoundError Solutions: No module named 'tools' I was really depressed. Why would this be an error??? Clearly PyCharm told me it was working fine!
